content:
This Space answers retail sales questions across three channels (Store, Catalog, Web) for years 1998-2003.
ALWAYS query measures with the MEASURE() function (e.g. MEASURE(`Total Sales`)); never SELECT raw measure columns. SELECT * is not supported on this metric view.
'Sales' or 'revenue' means MEASURE(`Total Sales`) (net paid after discounts, before tax). Use MEASURE(`Gross Sales`) only when the user explicitly asks for gross/list price before discounts.
Profit Margin and Average Order Value are pre-defined ratio measures; query them via MEASURE() rather than computing ratios yourself.
When the user asks for a year, filter on `Sale Year`; for month use `Sale Month` (1-12) and quarter use `Sale Quarter` (1-4).A small share of sales has no product category (NULL Category, the unlabeled bucket). When grouping or ranking by Category, exclude it with WHERE Category IS NOT NULL unless the user explicitly asks to include uncategorized sales.
